evidence.quote: Inflation has continued to run well below the Committee's 2 percent objective.
But the economy has improved considerably over the past two years, and I am optimistic that that this improvement will continue.
Last September, the FOMC published its Normalization Principles, which set forth its plans to reduce the balance sheet to a more normal level over time.
I am concerned about several troubling proposals that would subject monetary policy to undue political pressure and place new limits on the Fed's ability to respond to future crises.

parsed.rationale: The speech is mainly a defense of Fed independence and crisis-era actions against congressional proposals, with no signal on the future policy path. Its brief outlook remarks note an improving economy (mildly hawkish) and inflation well below 2 percent (mildly dovish), so the net stance is neutral.
